newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones jumped 103.52 points to 6,961.63. PLDT's ADR climbed $2 to $62.
* The peso closed weaker at 26.347 to a U.S. dollar from 26.345.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index shed 18.87 points to 3,339.83.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was at 10.53125 percent from 10.5625.
* President Fidel Ramos finally signs the 1997 national budget of 433.8 billion pesos after two months of delay and vetoes a provision to use special funds for a plebiscite (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
* President Ramos swims six laps at the presidential palace pool to prove he is in top shape after rumours surfaced that he collapsed in office. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

* The Makati Business Club, an association of 684 top businessmen, says it sees robust economic growth this year as gross national product (GNP) is expected to exceed the 6.8 percent posted in 1996 (CHRONICLE/MALAYA/BUSINESS DAILY)

* The Presidential Commission on Good Government says it has set the auction date of its Manila Electric Co (Meralco) shares totalling 30 million valued at about six billion pesos not later than March this year. (BUSINESSWORLD)
